numerical_claims.source_evidence: Significant events after the end of the year states: 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. SEK 820 M) for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers for the EPS-Sterna satellite programme.'

numerical_claims.claim: Data and Services net sales grew 80 percent to SEK 80 million
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 80 million SEK (2025) vs ~45 million SEK (2024) with 80% growth
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 Segment Information shows Data & Services net sales of SEK 80,142 (2025) vs SEK 44,887 (2024). Growth is (80,142 - 44,887)/44,887 = 78.7%, which rounds to 80%.

numerical_claims.claim: Data and Services EBITDA rose to SEK 28 million from SEK 21 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 Segment Information shows Data & Services EBITDA of SEK 27,801 (2025) vs SEK 21,121 (2024). Values round to 28 million and 21 million respectively.
